summary: Completed comprehensive testing of BookSlot multi-tenant SaaS booking platform. Tested landing page, auth flows, onboarding wizard, dashboard, and public booking functionality. Found minor backend serialization issue but core functionality works.

flaky_endpoints.issue: Returns 500 due to MongoDB ObjectId serialization error in response
flaky_endpoints.impact: Tenant creation works (data saved to DB) but response fails

ui_bugs.issue: Onboarding completion doesn't redirect to dashboard due to backend error

passed_tests: Landing page loads with hero section and AI receptionist badge
Navigation to Features and Pricing pages works
Login page loads with email/password form and Google login button
Signup page loads with registration form and Google signup button
Onboarding wizard 3-step flow works (business name, industry, contact)
Dashboard loads with stats cards and quick actions after login
Public booking page loads at correct URL format
AI receptionist widget appears on public pages
JWT auth login works with registered users
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue in tenant creation endpoint. The data is being saved correctly but the API response fails due to ObjectId not being JSON serializable. This prevents proper onboarding completion flow.
success_percentage: Backend: 80% (core functionality works, serialization issue), Frontend: 95% (all UI elements work, minor redirect issue)
